positions.commentary: The speaker highlights that CPRT managed to maintain ASPs despite a 12% drop in the used car market and has successfully pivoted back to whole car initiatives organically.
Amazon is used as an example of a company where required free cash flow growth rates were too high when cash flow was absent, but normalizing cash conversion levels makes the scenario sensible.
The speaker mentions Constellation Software as an example of a company that bought an oil company, which would have been a very different scenario.
The speaker mentions Mark Leonard and Jay Adair as examples of people one would trust, in the context of discussing companies like Copart and Constellation Software.
The speaker mentions Deer (Deere) and Nintendo as two other companies written about recently that are in a transition phase.
Ferrari uses an interesting strategy of creating more models instead of manufacturing more volume of the same model to maintain exclusivity and resale value.
